paper_title: DraftAttention: Fast Video Diffusion via Low-Resolution Attention Guidance
original_abstract: Diffusion transformer–based video generation models (DiTs) have recently attracted widespread attention for their excellent generation quality. However, their computational cost remains a major bottleneck—attention alone accounts for over 80% of total latency, and generating just 8 seconds of 720p video takes tens of minutes—posing serious challenges to practical application and scalability. To address this, we propose the DraftAttention, a training-free framework for the acceleration of video diffusion transformers with dynamic sparse attention on GPUs. We apply down-sampling to each feature map across frames in the compressed latent space, enabling a higher-level receptive field over the latent composed of hundreds of thousands of tokens. The low-resolution draft attention map, derived from draft query and key, exposes redundancy both spatially within each feature map and temporally across frames. We reorder the query, key, and value based on the draft attention map to guide the sparse attention computation in full resolution, and subsequently restore their original order after the attention computation. This reordering enables structured sparsity that aligns with hardware-optimized execution. Our theoretical analysis demonstrates that the low-resolution draft attention closely approximates the full attention, providing reliable guidance for constructing accurate sparse attention. Experimental results show that our method outperforms existing sparse attention approaches in video generation quality and achieves up to 1.75× end-to-end speedup on GPUs.

innovative_points.description: Uses 8×16 average pooling to create low-resolution draft attention maps that approximate full attention with bounded error
innovative_points.theoretical_justification: Frobenius norm bound ∥S-S_draft∥_F ≤ δn proves approximation quality

innovative_points.description: Deterministic token reordering algorithm that groups spatial patches into contiguous memory blocks for efficient GPU execution
innovative_points.runtime_change: Adds O(n) memory operations, enables coalesced memory access

innovative_points.description: No retraining required, plug-and-play integration with existing video diffusion transformers
innovative_points.compatibility: Works with HunyuanVideo, Wan2.1, and other DiT models

innovative_points.description: Region-level sparsity that aligns with GPU block processing, enabling efficient sparse attention kernels
innovative_points.hardware_optimization: Compatible with FlashAttention and Block Sparse Attention

innovative_points.description: Provides provable bounds on approximation error introduced by both draft attention and sparsity masking

improvements.name: Adaptive Kernel Selection
improvements.description: Automatically select pooling kernel based on resolution and content complexity
improvements.runtime_change: Add [k, d, k] where k << n for kernel selection

improvements.name: Dynamic Sparsity Adjustment
improvements.description: Adjust sparsity ratio based on attention entropy and content complexity
improvements.runtime_change: Add [g, g] entropy computation + threshold adjustment

improvements.name: 3D Spatial-Temporal Pooling
improvements.description: Extend pooling to temporal dimension for better redundancy detection

improvements.name: Content-Aware Sparsity
improvements.description: Use optical flow to detect motion and adjust sparsity accordingly
improvements.runtime_change: Add [H, W, 2] flow computation per frame
improvements.strategy: High motion: 60-70% sparsity, Low motion: 80-90% sparsity

improvements.name: Multi-Scale Draft Attention
improvements.description: Compute draft attention at multiple scales and fuse for better guidance

improvements.name: Automatic Sparsity Selection
improvements.description: Use lightweight quality predictor to automatically select optimal sparsity
